params.name: status
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Request status. Allowed values: in_process, approved, rejected, pre_approved, incomplete, cancel_request, canceled

params.name: person_id
params.description: (OPTIONAL) ID of the person who requested the benefit. Used to filter requests from a specific person.

params.name: available_version_id
params.description: (OPTIONAL) ID of the specific version of the requested benefit.

params.name: requested_at_from
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Date from which to filter requests (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Allows searching for requests made from a specific date onwards

params.name: requested_at_to
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Date up to which to filter requests (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Allows searching for requests made up to a specific date

params.name: page
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Page number for result pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified

params.name: per_page
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Number of records per page (maximum 100). Default is 25 if not specified

params.name: sort_by
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Field by which to sort the results. Allowed values: id, person_id, approver_id, available_version_id, status, points_cost, requested_at, status_date, created_at

params.name: sort_order
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Sort direction. Allowed values: asc (ascending), desc (descending). Default is desc
